_comment: Network Device CLI Escape Attempt. Generated from rules/network_device_cli_escape.yml by tools/build.py; do not edit.

properties.description: A Telnet or SSH session sends the bare words that break out of a router or IoT vendor CLI into a Linux shell (enable, system, shell, sh, linuxshell). Mirai-family bots send this sequence blindly to every device before running their payload. On a honeypot it identifies the bot family; on a real device it means someone is trying to reach the underlying OS.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Network Device CLI Escape Attempt from {{src_ip}}
